people.imagined: Before first light on the river shore, the cloud-sky still grey. She has ground her ink and is about to paint the morning cloud on a hanging sheet. Someone has stepped in from behind and she pauses with the brush lifted, thinking of a fire talisman she refuses to paint.
people.subject: The moment: in the grey minutes before sunrise she holds a brush lifted just off a sheet of pale paper and turns her head toward the viewer, the brush tip still wet. Face: a small, slight oval face with a pointed chin; fair skin, a little sallow from early rising; very straight low brows; narrow dark-brown eyes with faint shadows beneath; a thin nose; a firm pale mouth; ink-grey stains on her cheek and fingertips. Hair: black, pinned up in a tight round knot with a single long ink brush pushed through it like a hairpin, its goat-hair tip pointing up and to the left; this brush must be clearly visible. A few fine hairs have slipped from the knot and cling to her neck, and the brush's goat-hair tip is stained grey. Body: slight and narrow-shouldered, very upright. Clothing: a plain robe of mulberry-brown hemp, fine and clean, with a high crossed collar; over it a mulberry-grey sleeveless jacket; sleeves rolled once at the cuffs, with grey ink to the elbow. The grey jacket's seams are neatly stitched in matching thread and the brown robe's cuffs are rolled once, showing a strip of paler lining. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the long brush, fingertips stained slate grey; the left holds the edge of a hanging sheet of blank mulberry paper with a few loose swirls of grey cloud painted on it, no characters. Background: blurred pale river mist and the dark silhouettes of mulberry trees, a thin line of rose at the horizon. Behind her, a second sheet hangs on a line, already dry, and a stone ink dish stands on a low stool. Light: faint cool dawn light from the upper left, a warm hint on her brush hand. Qi: a barely visible green-blue haze, like damp air, along the brush. Expression: patient, severe, tired, resolved.

people.imagined: A reception at the old seat. He has just finished quoting a couplet and is waiting for the effect, one hand lifted in mid-gesture. His robe is a shade too close to the lord's violet. He is smiling at someone he wants something from.
people.subject: The moment: mid-conversation at a reception, he lifts one hand in a small flourish after a quotation and smiles warmly and slightly too long at the viewer. Face: handsome, long-jawed and smooth; olive skin; high forehead; grey at both temples in two clean silver wings against black hair; arched dark brows; bright dark eyes with fine smile lines; a straight nose; a well-shaped mouth with a practised, even smile. Hair: black, with silver wings at the temples, tied in a neat high knot with a dark wood pin; a short, trimmed beard-shadow on the chin. The silver wings at his temples are clean and combed back; a faint scent of sandalwood clings to him. Body: tall, straight-backed, elegant. Clothing: an inner robe of pale mulberry-grey hemp; over it a long robe of fine dusk-violet silk, its hem the same violet as the lord's colour but a shade bluer, with wide, soft sleeves; a pale grey sash. The sash is fastened with a small jade toggle, and a thin violet thread runs along the cuffs. Hands and objects: his right hand is raised at shoulder height with two fingers extended, as if making a point; his left hand holds a long silk banner folded over his forearm, painted with a plain red beam and blue cloud, no writing. Background: blurred warm lantern light and the red of maple leaves through an open doorway. Light: warm evening light from the upper left, flattering and golden. Qi: a faint blue-green mist at the sleeve. Expression: charming, calculating, hungry for favour. Under the warmth in his face is a flicker of watchfulness, the look of a man weighing what each listener could give him.

people.imagined: Dawn again, the three-thousandth identical cloud. She sits at her board with her jaw set and does not look up until the brush is lifted. A thick yellow callus on her finger is what she looks at.
people.subject: The moment: seated at a writing board at dawn, she looks up sharply from her work with a mouth pressed into a thin line. On the shelf behind her lie three thousand identical sheets in tied bundles, and she has not once looked at them since lifting her brush. Face: a hard, bony face with a flat forehead; skin weathered and sallow; a tight mouth with the corners pulled down; deep lines running from nose to chin; narrow dark eyes under straight heavy brows; a stubborn square chin. Hair: grey-streaked black, scraped back flat and wound into a hard knot with a plain wooden pin. A few grey hairs are mixed in the black near the parting, scraped flat with water. Body: lean and stiff, shoulders held high. Clothing: a mulberry-grey hemp robe, well kept, crossed collar buttoned to the throat, narrow sleeves tied back with cord; ink to the elbow. Hands and objects: her right hand holds a brush upright; the callus on the first finger is the size of a pea, a bright yellow-white lump, large in the frame; before her on the board lies a sheet with one grey cloud, finished and perfect, no characters. Background: dim dawn-grey wall, a stack of identical grey cloud sheets blurred on a shelf. A narrow high window shows a grey sky and a thin line of rose where the sun is about to come. Light: cool grey light from the upper left. Qi: a faint wash of green-blue on the sheet. Expression: bitter, controlled, unforgiving.

people.imagined: Night at the Jade Milk spring among the stone pillars. He is grinding ink, wearing his gloves, and looks up at a sound. The ink in the dish is darker than it should be, and he does not want anyone to see it.
people.subject: The moment: at night beside a spring he stops grinding an ink stick and looks sideways toward the viewer with wary, slightly widened eyes. Face: pale and narrow, almost grey-white, like skin kept from the sun; a long thin nose; a thin mouth held shut; hollow cheeks; dark-ringed eyes of very dark brown; thin black eyebrows; faint black veins visible at the temple. Hair: black, tied low at the nape with a grey cloth, loose strands at the sides. Body: stooped, narrow-shouldered, held tight. His shoulders are slightly rounded as if to keep his chest from showing; his neck is long and pale. Clothing: a mulberry-grey hemp robe, fine and clean, the collar high; both hands in thin black cloth gloves that reach his sleeves, the gloves lightly stained. The robe's cuffs are tucked inside the gloves, and a faint dark stain has seeped through at the left wrist. Hands and objects: he holds a black ink stick over a shallow stone dish of very dark, glossy ink; a faint dark thread of mist lifts from the dish. Background: blurred wet grey limestone pillars and a dim spring pool. Light: cold pale blue light from the upper left; the ink dish shines. Qi: a thin black-violet thread curling off the ink. Expression: wary, guarded, ashamed. His look is that of a man who wants very much to be left alone and knows he will not be.

people.imagined: At the paper mill, mid-sneeze. White pulp dust floats in the light. He is holding up a fresh wet sheet to the window, the sneeze coming for the third time.
people.subject: The moment: at his mill, he holds a thin sheet of paper up to the light with both hands and is caught the instant before a sneeze, nose scrunched, eyes squeezed shut. Face: round, full-cheeked and ruddy; a broad nose and a wide mouth; thick brows; the whole face and hair dusted white with fine paper pulp; his eyelashes are white. Hair: grey-black, cropped short, white with dust. His eyebrows and the hairs in his ears are white with pulp. Body: broad and sturdy, short, strong forearms. Clothing: a mulberry-grey hemp robe, fine but floury with white dust, the sleeves rolled to the elbow; a leather apron over the front. The leather apron has a long crack near the hem and the robe beneath is sprinkled with white from collar to knee. Hands and objects: both hands lift a pale translucent sheet of mulberry paper, the window light shining through its fibres. Background: blurred wooden vats and drying racks, steam, the white sparkle of dust in the sunlight. Light: bright white morning light from the upper left, dust glittering. Qi: none visible; a very faint green warmth in the paper. Expression: comic, kind, about to sneeze. His eyes are wet from the dust and his whole round face is scrunched up in the instant before the sneeze.

people.imagined: Midday at her stall. A customer has paused to haggle, and she has switched her laugh on. Her eyes are not laughing. Six rings flash on her counting hand.
people.subject: The moment: behind a market stall she laughs warmly with her mouth wide, her eyes cold and measuring a customer's face. Face: round, pretty, plump-cheeked with a double chin; powdered pale skin; carefully painted red lips; arched drawn brows; dark eyes sharp and level while the mouth smiles; a small beauty mark under the right eye. Hair: glossy black, in a high coil with two small gilt combs and a sprig of artificial peach blossom. Body: plump, comfortable, leaning forward over a counter. Clothing: a mulberry-grey hemp robe of the best cloth, with a violet hem peeking out and a coral-coloured sash. The coral sash is tied with a flat bow, and a faint violet hem peeks from beneath the grey robe; the sleeve edges are embroidered with tiny gold clouds. Hands and objects: her right hand, raised near the face, wears six rings, two on the thumb and one on each finger, in bronze and jade; her left hand lays a sheet of plain blank talisman paper with a red-brown stamp on the counter. The six rings are a thin silver one, two jade ones on the thumb, a red coral one, a brass one and a plain gold one, flashing as she gestures. Background: blurred market awning in red cloth and hanging yellow paper sheets, a crowd of vague shapes. Light: warm bright afternoon light from the upper left. Qi: none. Expression: a salesperson's laugh, a hard eye. A smile like a lamp switched on, the eyes cool and fixed on the customer's rings and boots.

people.imagined: Dawn on a brook bank in spring. She is painting a name on a pink petal and humming, tongue between her teeth. She doesn't notice the viewer yet.
people.subject: The moment: on a spring brook bank at dawn she bends over a tiny task, humming, and glances up at the viewer with a startled smile. Face: round, soft and freckled; rosy cheeks; wide dark-brown eyes with long lashes; a small button nose; a gap between her front teeth; no wrinkle. Hair: black, in two short buns tied with pink thread, with petals stuck in them. Body: small and sturdy, leaning forward on her knees. Her shoulders are rounded and her hands small with short, stubby fingers. Clothing: a mulberry-grey hemp robe, new and clean, the sleeves pushed up; the cuffs and sleeves stained with soft pink and yellow petal juice; a pale-green cord around the waist. The petal stains are pink on the left sleeve and yellow on the right; her hem is damp from the bank. Hands and objects: her fingertips pinch a pink petal and a very fine brush writes a tiny grey swirl on it; a small heap of pink and white petals lies on a flat stone. Background: blurred green bank, a clear brook with floating petals, peach blossoms in soft focus. Light: soft rosy morning light from the upper left. Qi: a faint pale-green glimmer along the petal. Expression: bright, shy and delighted. A hum is still on her lips, and her whole face is open and unguarded, as if the viewer were an old friend.

people.imagined: In the courtyard, a letter just sent home. He is straightening his brush case again because someone looked at it. He is anxious that his cousin will come and outshine him.
people.subject: The moment: he stands holding a brush case against his chest with both hands, straightening it by a hair as someone glances at it, and looks anxiously at the viewer. Face: a thin, handsome, well-bred young face; pale skin; an anxious dent between the brows; smooth dark eyes with a defensive stare; a narrow nose; a mouth held in a polite half-smile; a small nick on the chin. Hair: black, in a neat high knot with a plain wood pin, one strand escaping. Body: tall, thin, tense shoulders. Clothing: a good Phong Lâm family coat in blue-grey cloth, clearly let out at the hem, with a visible lighter band where the hem was lowered; over it a mulberry-grey hemp outer robe, fine and clean. Hands and objects: a lacquered brush case, black with a single gold line, held in both hands at his chest. On the brush case's lid a single gold line runs around the edge; his thumbs worry it nervously. Background: blurred courtyard wall and the red of maples. A grey wall with a round window and a stone lantern at the edge. Light: soft cloudy light from the upper left. Qi: none. Expression: polite, stiff and worried. He holds the smile he has practised, but his eyes keep sliding toward the brush case.

people.imagined: On the dock at dusk, he is carrying a jar of dark ink down from the spring, hands hidden in his sleeves. A stern lamp glows on a boat behind him. He is thinking of the winter storm.
people.subject: The moment: at dusk on a harbour jetty, he stands with both hands pulled up inside his sleeves and looks down and sideways at the viewer; behind him a boat's stern lamp is lit. The ink jar is warm against his chest and the lamp on the stern behind him has just been lit; he will paint the charm tonight. Face: a young fisher boy's face, salt-burnt dark brown and weathered; chapped lips; narrow black eyes; a straight nose; short thick brows; cheeks windburnt red. Hair: black and salt-stiff, cut short and uneven. Salt has stiffened the hair into little spikes at the front. Body: thin and wiry, shoulders hunched. Clothing: a mulberry-grey hemp robe of good cloth, its cuffs long and deep; a faded blue fisher's neck scarf at his throat; as he pulls a sleeve a few inches back one wrist shows, grey to the wrist, as if dipped in ash. The sleeves are so long that his hands vanish inside them, and the cuffs are dark with spray. Hands and objects: one grey hand holds a small stoppered clay jar of very dark ink against his chest. Background: blurred wooden jetty, a small boat with a round red-orange stern lamp glowing, dark sea. Light: dusk light from the upper left; the lamp gives a warm spot. Qi: a faint thread of dark violet near the jar. Expression: wary, devout, patient.

people.imagined: At the stall, she has just spotted a customer's fat purse and her eyes have gone straight to it. The abacus bead at her neck swings. She is already counting.
people.subject: The moment: standing at a stall counter, she glances at something below the viewer's face, as if at a purse, her eyes dropped, then flicks up with a quick sweet smile. Face: a sharp, pretty face with a pointed chin; light brown skin; quick, narrow, bright eyes; arched thin brows; a thin mouth with a faint smirk; a tiny dimple. Hair: black, in a high ponytail tied with a red thread, with a few loose strands. Her ponytail is tied with a red thread that matches the cord at her waist; two strands curl by her ear. Body: slim, quick, leaning toward the counter. Clothing: a new mulberry-grey hemp robe, closely fitted, a red cord at the waist; at her throat on a cord, one big wooden abacus bead that swings. Hands and objects: both hands rest on the counter, the right one holding a single copper coin between two fingers. Background: blurred market stall with hanging paper sheets and a sweeper girl in the distance holding a broom. A little girl with a broom is a blur at the far end of the stall. Light: bright warm light from the upper left. Qi: none. Expression: sweet and greedy. Her sweet look and the flick of her eyes to the purse are so quick a customer would miss it.

people.imagined: On a path between the mill and the river, sitting on a stone to rest after twenty steps, braiding a hemp bracelet, happy.
people.subject: The moment: seated on a roadside stone, resting, he is braiding a hemp cord and looks up at the viewer with an easy lazy smile. He rests every twenty steps and this is the nineteenth; a dragonfly has landed on the stone beside him. Face: a pale, soft, narrow face; thin cheeks and light shadows under the eyes; gentle round dark eyes; a mild, slightly open mouth; a rope-burn across the palms visible in a raised hand. Hair: black and loose, tied back at the nape with a hemp cord, a few strands on the forehead. A strand of hair has been woven into the bracelet he is braiding. Body: thin, narrow-chested, slumped. Clothing: a mulberry-grey hemp robe, fine and clean, the sleeves loosened; a hemp rope belt tied in a loose bow. Hands and objects: both open palms show a red rope-burn band across each; his fingers weave a half-finished hemp bracelet of pale cord. Background: blurred green riverbank, a rope bridge in the soft distance. Light: gentle afternoon light from the upper left. Qi: none. Expression: easy, content, unhurried. There is no worry on his face at all, only the slow pleasure of a day with nothing in it.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at the dawn she first found her paintings held qi. A brush in each fist, the sky behind her head.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened; she stands with a long brush clenched upright in each fist, the dawn sky glowing behind her head like a halo, at the dawn she first found her paintings held qi. Face: a square, plain, strong face with brown skin, high cheekbones, thick straight brows, clear dark eyes looking straight out, a wide firm mouth and fine lines at the eyes. Hair: black, in a plain tight knot with two brushes thrust through it so they stand like two small antennae. Body: tall, broad-shouldered and vigorous, standing square. Clothing: an undyed hemp robe in mulberry-grey, simple, neat and well cut, the hem a little dusty from walking the shore, a stripe of grey paint along each cuff. Hands and objects: a long brush in each hand held upright like two tall wands, both tips grey with paint. Background: a pale sky streaked with painted grey-white clouds and a rose dawn, the shore a dark stripe below. Light: dawn glow from behind spreading in a faint halo, a soft light on her face from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue-green glow around the brush tips. Expression: fierce, absorbed calm, the mouth firm and the gaze level and unblinking, a painter who has just seen her work come alive and is not going to say so.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the heavy, laughing co-founder looking away at the hills, a pearl-beaded merchant's cap on his head.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with the edges darkened; a heavy man in mid-laugh looks away toward distant hills rather than at the viewer. Face: broad, ruddy and round with a double chin, deep laugh lines, small bright eyes crinkled nearly shut, a big nose, a wide laughing mouth and a thin drooping moustache. Hair: black going grey, hidden under a merchant's cap strung with a fringe of small white pearl beads that hang over his forehead and swing as he laughs; this pearl-beaded cap must be clearly visible. Body: heavy and big-bellied, relaxed, the round belly pushing the loose robe forward and the shoulders shaking with the laugh. Clothing: a good bay merchant's robe of mulberry-grey hemp with a violet hem, loose and wide-sleeved, unbelted, the hem darkened where river water has splashed it. Hands and objects: one hand rests on his belly; the other holds a loose rolled blank scroll lightly. Background: pale washed hills under a pale grey curtain of rain, with a pale grey bay lying beneath them and the faint lines of the falling rain. Light: soft late-afternoon light from the upper left. Qi: a faint blue haze of rain. Expression: a loud, idle, unbothered laugh, the eyes creased shut and the whole face given over to the joke, a man at ease with the world and entirely sure it will pay.

people.imagined: Late afternoon at the scribes' desk. He is bent over the lord's war orders copying them and hears his name called; he straightens, left shoulder dipped from years of stooping.
people.subject: The moment: bent at a low writing desk, he looks up from his copying with his left shoulder noticeably lower than the right, the brush still held over the page. The lord's order he is copying is long and he has been stooping since noon; his left shoulder aches. Face: a long, mild, narrow face; sallow skin; heavy-lidded patient brown eyes; thin straight brows; a long straight nose; a mouth closed in a small neutral line; faint ink on the chin. Hair: black, in a plain low knot with a wooden pin. A violet thread is wound through the knot. Body: slim, with a visible stoop leaning to the left. Clothing: a mulberry-grey hemp robe of fine cloth, clean, with a narrow violet thread edging the hem and showing at the lower edge of the frame and the cuff; plain sleeves tied back. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a small brush above a sheet of blank paper with a few neat rows of tiny grey marks, no characters; the left hand pins down the paper corner with a brass weight. Background: blurred wooden shelves and rolled scrolls, a small oil lamp. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left. Qi: faint blue-green haze at the brush. Expression: loyal, patient, quietly sad. His eyes are patient and sad, those of a man who wants one thing and is not allowed to ask.

people.imagined: At a talisman contest she stands at her champion's shoulder, forearms folded, face still. She is grinding ink and has already decided the contest is lost.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside a contest table with her arms crossed, she looks level at the viewer and gives away nothing. Ninh's ink is ground first, before her own, and the contest's judge has just walked past without looking at either. Face: a plain, flat, broad face with a wide forehead; brown skin; small level dark eyes; thin plain brows; a short nose; a thick closed mouth; no expression lines. Hair: black, in a plain bun at the back of the head, with a wrapped grey cloth band. The bun is wrapped with a strip of grey cloth and a pencil-thin brush is stuck through it. Body: broad-shouldered and strong. Clothing: a mulberry-grey hemp robe, fine and clean, the sleeves pushed to above the elbow showing thick muscular bark-beater's forearms, brown and corded. Hands and objects: her left hand grips her right elbow; at her feet-side edge a stone ink dish and ink stick stand ready on the table, the stick worn short. Background: blurred long contest table with sheets of pale paper in rows, a bright window. Light: even grey daylight from the upper left. Qi: none. Expression: stone-faced, poker-faced, resigned. Her face does not move; a faint downward tug of the mouth is all that shows she knows.

people.imagined: She is up before dawn without being told, wetting down a stubborn cowlick at the well, sunburnt to the elbows, and smiles at the first person she sees.
people.subject: The moment: at a well in the dark before dawn, she pats a wet palm on the crown of her head to flatten a cowlick and smiles broadly at the viewer. Face: a round, open, sunburnt face with a peeling nose; big trusting brown eyes; thick brows; a wide smile with slightly crooked teeth; a few freckles. Hair: brown-black, with a tuft at the crown that sticks straight up despite the wet hand; the rest in two short plaits. The plaits are tied with undyed cord. Body: sturdy, short, a little clumsy. Clothing: a new mulberry-grey hemp robe with sleeves pushed to the elbow; her forearms are bright red with sunburn from the elbow down, lighter above the elbow, clearly two-toned; a coarse brown apron. Hands and objects: one hand on her hair, a wooden water bucket on the well's rim beside her. Background: blurred stone well and a pale grey pre-dawn sky, a single star. Light: faint cool blue light from the upper left. A faint blue light grows in the east, and a lantern hung from the well-post gives a small yellow glow on her cheek. Qi: none. Expression: cheerful, trusting, content. She has been up since the dark and her cheerful smile is slightly sleepy.

people.imagined: He walks the path from the spring with his eyes on the ground, his own hands and neck marked grey-brown with ink, thinking of the stones he sends home.
people.subject: The moment: walking a stony path with his head bowed, he lifts only his eyes to the viewer, shy and wary. Face: a thin, long, dark-tanned face with a heavy brow and a large straight nose; blotches of grey-brown ink staining one cheek and the side of his neck, plainly visible; small black eyes under a lowered head; a thin mouth. Hair: black, wild and unevenly cut, tied with a bit of cord. Bits of dry moss cling to his hair. Body: lean, wiry, shoulders hunched, looks half wild. Clothing: a mulberry-grey hemp robe of good cloth, a little large; both hands and the neck above the collar blotched with grey-brown stains like thin mould. Hands and objects: both stained hands hold a rolled sheet of dark grey paper against his chest. Background: blurred grey limestone rocks and moss, a pale hollow of the Jade Milk spring. Light: cool dim light from the upper left. A pale blue light filters down from a gap in the rocks overhead. Qi: a thin black-violet shimmer on the stains. Expression: shy, wary, reclusive. His eyes dart away if the viewer looks too long, and his shoulders hunch as if to hide the stains.

people.imagined: At the stall, on a quiet afternoon, he stamps a sheet and eavesdrops on the Counting House clerks at lunch. One brush behind each ear and ink on his cuffs, grin ready.
people.subject: The moment: he leans on the stall counter with an easy grin, eyes turned a little aside as if listening to a conversation nearby, a stamp raised in his hand. Two clerks at the next stall are talking about wages, and he is memorising each word to sell it later. Face: a lively, narrow, freckled face; sharp chin; quick light-brown eyes; arched brows; a lopsided grin; a small scar in one eyebrow. A thin white scar lies through the left eyebrow and a small dimple sits at the corner of his grin. Hair: brown-black, short and messy, with a stub of pencil-like charcoal tucked behind each ear, both clearly visible. The charcoal stubs behind his ears are almost worn to nothing. Body: slim, wiry, loose-limbed. Clothing: a mulberry-grey hemp robe of fine cloth with ink-black smears on both cuffs; a cheap red neck scarf. The ink on his cuffs is black and blue, and the red scarf is tied in a flat knot at the throat; he swears the ink is from the seal. Hands and objects: his right hand holds a wooden stamp with a round carved cloud on its face above a sheet of blank paper; the left rests on the counter. Background: blurred market stall awning and hanging paper sheets, clerks in the distance. A bright gap in the awning shows a bit of blue sky. Light: warm bright light from the upper left. Qi: none. Expression: charming, sly, eager. His grin is open and friendly, while his ears are tuned to the clerks.

people.imagined: Beside the mistress's desk at dawn, grinding ink, her head tilted toward a whisper, one finger pressed on the pot lid so nobody can look inside.
people.subject: The moment: at a desk she tilts her head sideways to catch a whisper out of frame and presses one fingertip on the lid of an ink pot, her eyes sliding to the viewer. A whisper has come from the mistress's desk, and the ink pot's lid presses shut under her finger. Face: a smooth, pretty oval face with a small pointed chin; pale skin; narrow, almond-shaped dark eyes that look sidelong; thin arched brows; a small tight smile; a tiny mole above the lip. Hair: glossy black, in a neat low coil with a silver pin. The silver pin is shaped like a small crane. Body: slim, head cocked, shoulders turned inward. Clothing: a mulberry-grey hemp robe, fine and crisp, with a faint violet edge at the inner collar; the cuffs spotless, in contrast to the stained sleeve of the others. Hands and objects: the first finger of her right hand presses down on a small round lid of a black ink pot, held shut; the left hand rests on a folded sheet of paper at the desk edge. Background: blurred desk with piled blank paper, a dim window, a door ajar. Light: cool dawn light from the upper left. Qi: none. Expression: attentive, falsely innocent, eager. Her eyes slide to the side and a small, practised innocence settles on her face.

people.imagined: Beating bark at the mill, whistling two notes of a tune and never the third, glancing at Văn Tiểu Tang with a plot to swap jobs.
people.subject: The moment: whistling with pursed lips, he rests a wooden bark mallet on his shoulder and winks at the viewer; he whistles the first two notes of a song and skips the third, as he always does, with a plan to swap jobs. Face: a broad, round, ruddy face with a wide flat nose, small bright crinkled eyes, thick brows, pursed lips mid-whistle and sweat on the forehead, a small flicker of conspiracy in the eyes. Hair: black, cropped very short, with dry flakes of mulberry bark caught in it. Body: stocky with strong shoulders and thick forearms, the shoulder under the strap knotted with muscle from beating bark. Clothing: a mulberry-grey hemp robe of fine cloth, its hem dusted with pale pulp, the sleeves rolled to the shoulder, and a polished leather strap across the chest. Hands and objects: the right hand holds the long wooden bark mallet over his shoulder; the left hand, palm open and visibly stripped and pale pink from the work, is raised in a half wave. Background: blurred wet bark piles and mill vats in sunlit steam. Light: bright morning light from the upper left. Qi: none. Expression: a cheerful, easy, mischievous face, the wink slow and the whistle breathy, the sly delight of a young man who means to trade his work for an easier job the moment the masters look away.
